cold_open: Two lineups were perfect this week. Evan's scored 92.45, the week's best, and would have beaten all eleven other teams. Tom's scored 51.63, the week's worst, and would have lost to all eleven.

notes.Kevin O'Boyle|Shawn: The week's biggest blowout, by 32.27. Shawn was projected for 86.8 and scored 57.16, 29.64 under, the furthest below projection in the league. O'Boyle snapped Shawn's two-game streak; Shawn leads 18–13.
notes.Steve Swanson|Thomas: The luckiest win: Steve's 69.19 was ninth-best, with Derrick Henry's 1.5 starting over Rachaad White's 10.85. Tom's lineup was perfect and scored 51.63. Steve's first win over him since 2023; Tom leads 16–10.
notes.Douglas|Jeff: The narrowest win: 0.16. Stefon Diggs scored 11.2 on Jeff's bench while Ladd McConkey scored 1.35 at flex. Jeff has scored the league's most points, 555.57, and is 2–4. Doug leads 9–5.
notes.Eric|Evan: Evan's lineup was perfect: 92.45, the week's best and 20.3 over projection. Eric's best possible lineup would have won by 0.3; his biggest miss was Kyle Pitts Sr.'s 17.5 on the bench behind Brenton Strange's 4.7. Series even, 2–2.
notes.Brian Clark|Kevin Swanson: They came in tied at 194 career wins. Clark won 76.28–66.69 and takes the all-time lead at 195. It's his fifth straight over Swanson, the longest run in the series, and his 19–13 lead has never been wider.
notes.Dominic|Fadi: The unluckiest loss: Dominic's 77.06 was fourth-best. Fadi beat his projection by 20.97, behind Trevor Lawrence's 28.67, the quarterback of the week. Four straight for Fadi ties the series record; his 18–12 lead has never been wider.

kicker: Kevin O'Boyle came into the week 43.83 points short of 27,500 career points. His kicker, Tyler Bass, covered 17.0 of them, the most of any kicker this week.
